5.prompt: A spherical balloon is being inflated so that air is pumped in at a constant rate of 3 cubic centimeters per second. At the instant when the radius of the balloon is 4 centimeters, at what rate is the radius increasing?
5.why: Key wrong: dV/dt = 4πr²·dr/dt gives 3 = 64π·dr/dt, dr/dt = 3/(64π); the key said 3/(16π) and the right value was not an option (the stored rationale itself says 64π). Found by the third judge (Nemotron), confirmed by working it.
